text:
maya: Quick q — the SLO card in console shows 'notify policy: default' but not the routing weights. Can we surface per-policy fanout & quota usage inline? We need it for oncall triage.

joel: Agreed. Right now notify policy routing is hidden behind the API panel. Hard to debug why a tenant got alerts.

tara: The main blocker is we don't have a compact representation that doesn't bloat the card.

liam: Maybe show top-2 notification targets + an overflow count, and a hover or expand for full routing matrix.

maya: +1. Also want to see per-target remaining monthly quota and last-fired timestamp.

ops-bot: deploy queued: feature/console-slo-routing-preview -> staging (build 1123)

joel: API debate — should we call it 'notify_fanout_preview' on SLO read? Or add new /slo/:id/notify_preview endpoint?

tara: Prefer new endpoint. Keeps SLO read fast and cacheable. Preview can be async.

liam: If we add endpoint, we can return structured list but the UI will need simple text-only fallback for no-js clients.

maya: UX: small badge 'fanout: 3 targets' next to threshold. Click -> panel with per-target: name, type (email/slack/pagerduty), weight, quota usage, last sent.

joel: Also need telemetry: track when preview differs from live routing (e.g., after rollout).

tara: Add eval tag: user can opt-in to 'show routing preview from canary policy' for rollouts.

liam: Edge case: tenant-level overrides could cause policy to be absent. Show 'overrides active' pill.

maya: Example payload in case helpful:
```
GET /api/v1/slo/123/notify_preview
Response: [
  {"target":"#ops-oncall","type":"slack","weight":70,"quota_used":12,"last_sent":"2025-06-02T19:20:00Z"},
  {"target":"pagerduty:team-a","type":"pagerduty","weight":30,"quota_used":3,"last_sent":null}
]
```

joel: We should keep numbers human-friendly (e.g., '12/100 calls this month')

tara: Privacy check: make sure we don't leak webhook URLs or PD integration keys.

liam: Ops-bot will add a lint rule to redact secrets in preview.

ops-bot: note created: SLO-UI-485 add notify_preview endpoint + compact routing UI (assignee: tara)

maya: Cool. Can someone mock a small prototype? I'll add a couple of real cases from oncall logs.

tara: I'll spin up a quick Figma frame and wire it into the staging feature flag.

joel: timeline? would like this in the SLO rollout next week.

tara: aiming EOW for prototype, staging by mid next week. :crossed_fingers:

maya: Thanks all. tagging @liam to add telemetry events (preview_rendered, preview_discrepancy).

liam: on it. Also add metric: preview_vs_live_mismatch_count.
